proof_body:
by
  intro a c w z M hM hz
  have hw : 0 < ‖w - c‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg _) hz
  set ρ := ‖z - c‖ / ‖w - c‖ with hρ
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ρ := by positivity
  have h1 : ρ < 1 := (div_lt_one hw).mpr hz
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM 0)
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_) ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one h0 h1).mul_left M)
  have e : ‖z - c‖ ^ n = ρ ^ n * ‖w - c‖ ^ n := by
    rw [hρ, div_pow, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero n hw.ne')]
  calc ‖a n * (z - c) ^ n‖ = ‖a n‖ * ‖z - c‖ ^ n := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
    _ = (‖a n‖ * ‖w - c‖ ^ n) * ρ ^ n := by rw [e]; ring
    _ = ‖a n * (w - c) ^ n‖ * ρ ^ n := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
    _ ≤ M * ρ ^ n := by gcongr; exact hM n
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c w z : ℂ) (M : ℝ), (∀ n, ‖a n * (w - c) ^ n‖ ≤ M) → ‖z - c‖ < ‖w - c‖ → Summable (fun n => ‖a n * (z - c) ^ n‖)
